Messages.Author: Michael Bradley
Messages.Body:
It says "vampires do not get stealth when hunting."
Even vamps with a permanent +1 stealth still
hunt at zero stealth when there's a Strained Vitae in play, right?

If that's so, it could be a helpful way of catching up
with Jost, Muaziz or that Toreador wannabe Rebekka
and beating them to a bloody pulp...

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Michael Bradley wrote:
>
> It says "vampires do not get stealth when hunting."

Official (clarified) online card text: Vampires do not get the
normal +1 stealth when hunting.

> Even vamps with a permanent +1 stealth still
> hunt at zero stealth when there's a Strained Vitae in play, right?

No, they merely fail to get the normal +1 stealth of the hunt
action. Their built-in +1 stealth on all actions still applies.
